<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
  <title>Artisanal Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #060504;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }
    body:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
    #ramen-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      display: block;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="ramen-canvas"></canvas>

  <script>
  (function() {
    'use strict';

    const canvas = document.getElementById('ramen-canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

    // Accessibility: prefers-reduced-motion detection
    let prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').addEventListener('change', e => {
      prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
    });

    // Screen dimensions & DPI
    let width = 0;
    let height = 0;
    let dpr = 1;
    let bowlCenterX = 0;
    let bowlCenterY = 0;
    let baseScale = 1;

    // Mouse & Pointer State
    const mouse = {
      x: window.innerWidth / 2,
      y: window.innerHeight / 2,
      targetX: window.innerWidth / 2,
      targetY: window.innerHeight / 2,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      lastX: window.innerWidth / 2,
      lastY: window.innerHeight / 2,
      isDown: false,
      isHoveringBowl: false
    };

    // Parallax Tilt State
    const tilt = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      targetX: 0,
      targetY: 0
    };

    // Dynamic Lighting
    const light = {
      x: 0,
      y: -0.6,
      targetX: 0,
      targetY: -0.6,
      intensity: 1.0,
      warmthPulse: 0
    };

    // Interactive Ripples on broth
    const ripples = [];

    function addRipple(x, y, maxR = 90, strength = 1.0) {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
      ripples.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        r: 4,
        maxR: maxR,
        alpha: 0.65 * strength,
        speed: 1.4 + Math.random() * 0.4
      });
      if (ripples.length > 8) ripples.shift();
    }

    // Floating Oil Droplets (Rayu chili oil, aromatic scallion oil, sesame oil)
    const oilDroplets = [];
    const NUM_DROPLETS = 52;

    function initOilDroplets() {
      oilDroplets.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < NUM_DROPLETS; i++) {
        // Distribute within broth radius (~220 in bowl coords)
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        // Biased slightly toward edges and gaps between toppings
        const distRatio = 0.25 + 0.68 * Math.sqrt(Math.random());
        const baseR = distRatio * 205;
        
        // Types: 0: Chili oil (Rayu red), 1: Scallion oil (Jade green), 2: Sesame oil (Golden amber)
        const rand = Math.random();
        const type = rand < 0.5 ? 'chili' : (rand < 0.75 ? 'scallion' : 'sesame');
        const radius = type === 'chili' ? (2.5 + Math.random() * 6) : (type === 'scallion' ? (3 + Math.random() * 5.5) : (4 + Math.random() * 7));

        oilDroplets.push({
          angle: angle,
          dist: baseR,
          baseDist: baseR,
          angularSpeed: (0.0008 + Math.random() * 0.0016) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1),
          radialOffset: 0,
          radialPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          radius: radius,
          type: type,
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          vx: 0,
          vy: 0
        });
      }
    }

    // Steam Simulation Particles
    const steamParticles = [];
    const MAX_STEAM = 160;

    function createSteamParticle(initY = null) {
      // Spawn within the hot broth area, concentrated where broth is exposed
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const r = (Math.random() * 0.85) * 190;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * r * 1.05;
      const y = initY !== null ? initY : Math.sin(angle) * r * 0.82;

      const maxLife = prefersReducedMotion ? (240 + Math.random() * 100) : (140 + Math.random() * 110);

      return {
        x: x,
        y: y,
        spawnX: x,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
        vy: prefersReducedMotion ? -(0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4) : -(1.1 + Math.random() * 1.3),
        size: 14 + Math.random() * 12,
        maxSize: 65 + Math.random() * 55,
        alpha: 0,
        maxAlpha: 0.07 + Math.random() * 0.07,
        life: 0,
        maxLife: maxLife,
        curlSeed: Math.random() * 100,
        curlFreq: 0.022 + Math.random() * 0.018,
        curlAmp: prefersReducedMotion ? 0.15 : (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.9),
        depth: 1.1 + Math.random() * 0.5
      };
    }

    function initSteam() {
      steamParticles.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_STEAM; i++) {
        const p = createSteamParticle(-100 + Math.random() * 200);
        p.life = Math.random() * p.maxLife;
        steamParticles.push(p);
      }
    }

    // Ambient floating dust motes catching lantern light
    const motes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
      motes.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random(),
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.0004,
        vy: -0.0003 - Math.random() * 0.0006,
        size: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.8,
        alpha: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    // Responsive Canvas Resize
    function resize() {
      dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      width = window.innerWidth;
      height = window.innerHeight;

      canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);

      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

      bowlCenterX = width / 2;
      // Position bowl comfortably in lower-middle third
      bowlCenterY = height * 0.52;

      // Base scale: target ~540px bowl diameter on standard screens, responsive on mobile & large screens
      const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
      baseScale = Math.max(0.48, Math.min(1.22, minDim / 680));
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();
    initOilDroplets();
    initSteam();

    // Event Listeners for Smooth Mouse & Touch Response
    function updatePointer(clientX, clientY) {
      mouse.targetX = clientX;
      mouse.targetY = clientY;
    }

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
      updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    }, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
      mouse.isDown = true;
      updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);

      // Check if clicking inside bowl
      const dx = (e.clientX - bowlCenterX) / baseScale;
      const dy = (e.clientY - bowlCenterY) / baseScale;
      if (dx * dx + (dy / 0.8) * (dy / 0.8) < 220 * 220) {
        addRipple(dx, dy, 120, 1.4);
        light.warmthPulse = 0.25;

        // Puff of steam on gentle tap/click
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          if (steamParticles.length < MAX_STEAM + 20) {
            const p = createSteamParticle(dy);
            p.x = dx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            p.vy *= 1.35;
            p.maxAlpha *= 1.25;
            steamParticles.push(p);
          }
        }
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      mouse.isDown = false;
    });

    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
      mouse.isDown = false;
    });

    // Drawing Helpers
    function drawDarkTable(time) {
      // Atmospheric dark wood noodle counter
      const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        bowlCenterX + light.x * 60, bowlCenterY - 180 * baseScale + light.y * 40, 40 * baseScale,
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, Math.max(width, height) * 0.85
      );
      
      // Warm lantern cone fading to deep pitch black charred cedar
      const pulse = Math.sin(time * 0.9) * 0.015;
      bgGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(46, 26, 14, ${0.48 + pulse})`);
      bgGrad.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(24, 15, 9, ${0.75 + pulse})`);
      bgGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#0b0908');
      bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#040302');

      ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Subtle horizontal wood grain textures
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.045;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#deb887';
      const grainStep = 9 * baseScale;
      const startY = Math.floor((bowlCenterY - 300 * baseScale) / grainStep) * grainStep;
      for (let y = startY; y < height; y += grainStep) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1 + (Math.sin(y * 0.07) + 1) * 0.75;
        ctx.moveTo(0, y + Math.sin(y * 0.03) * 4);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          width * 0.33, y + Math.cos(y * 0.04) * 5,
          width * 0.66, y - Math.sin(y * 0.05) * 4,
          width, y + Math.cos(y * 0.03) * 3
        );
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // Atmospheric floating warm dust motes
      ctx.save();
      for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
        const m = motes[i];
        m.y += m.vy;
        m.x += m.vx + Math.sin(time * 0.5 + m.phase) * 0.0003;
        if (m.y < 0) m.y = 1;
        if (m.x < 0) m.x = 1;
        if (m.x > 1) m.x = 0;

        const px = m.x * width;
        const py = m.y * height;
        // Fade motes near boundaries and brighten near lantern beam
        const distFromCenter = Math.hypot(px - bowlCenterX, py - (bowlCenterY - 120));
        const beamIntensity = Math.max(0, 1 - distFromCenter / (420 * baseScale));

        if (beamIntensity > 0.05) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, m.size * baseScale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 160, ${m.alpha * beamIntensity * 0.8})`;
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Shadow cast by heavy stoneware bowl on table
    function drawBowlShadow(scale, tX, tY) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * -12, bowlCenterY + 45 * scale + tY * -8);

      // Deep ambient contact shadow
      const contactGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 45 * scale, 30 * scale, 0, 45 * scale, 250 * scale);
      contactGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95)');
      contactGrad.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.75)');
      contactGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(8, 5, 3, 0.35)');
      contactGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 45 * scale, 255 * scale, 125 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = contactGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Soft ambient table bounce from warm golden broth
      const bounceGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 50 * scale, 80 * scale, 0, 60 * scale, 270 * scale);
      bounceGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(215, 115, 30, 0.08)');
      bounceGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(160, 70, 10, 0.03)');
      bounceGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 60 * scale, 280 * scale, 110 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = bounceGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Stoneware Donburi Outer Vessel & Glaze
    function drawBowlBody(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 6, bowlCenterY + tY * 4);

      const R_OUTER_X = 258 * scale;
      const R_OUTER_Y = 215 * scale;
      const FOOT_R_X = 115 * scale;
      const FOOT_R_Y = 55 * scale;
      const BOWL_DEPTH = 135 * scale;

      // Outer vessel body path
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_OUTER_X, R_OUTER_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI); // Top rim half (front)
      // Taper down to heavy ceramic foot
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(
        R_OUTER_X * 0.95, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.55,
        FOOT_R_X * 1.35, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.95,
        FOOT_R_X, BOWL_DEPTH
      );
      ctx.ellipse(0, BOWL_DEPTH, FOOT_R_X, FOOT_R_Y * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI, false);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(
        -FOOT_R_X * 1.35, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.95,
        -R_OUTER_X * 0.95, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.55,
        -R_OUTER_X, 0
      );
      ctx.closePath();

      // Deep matte tenmoku / iron-black glaze with warm clay gradient
      const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-R_OUTER_X, -50 * scale, R_OUTER_X, BOWL_DEPTH);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1c1b1f');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.25, '#121214');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#0c0b0d');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.9, '#1a1410'); // warm unglazed clay near foot
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#110c08');

      ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Concentric hand-thrown pottery ribs
      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 235, 210, 0.035)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 * scale;
      for (let r = 0.2; r < 0.95; r += 0.16) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, BOWL_DEPTH * r, (R_OUTER_X * (1 - r * 0.45)), (R_OUTER_Y * 0.45 * (1 - r * 0.3)), 0, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Dynamic specular highlight on curved ceramic body
      const bodyHighlight = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 120 * scale, 40 * scale + lightVec.y * 30 * scale, 10 * scale,
        lightVec.x * 120 * scale, 50 * scale + lightVec.y * 30 * scale, 180 * scale
      );
      bodyHighlight.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 240, 215, 0.12)');
      bodyHighlight.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(220, 180, 140, 0.04)');
      bodyHighlight.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = bodyHighlight;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Rich Broth Surface, Golden Sheen & Convective Convection
    function drawBrothSurface(scale, tX, tY, time, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 16, bowlCenterY + tY * 12);

      const R_BROTH_X = 236 * scale;
      const R_BROTH_Y = 192 * scale;

      // Broth clipping mask
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_BROTH_X, R_BROTH_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      // Deep Tonkotsu-Shoyu Vegan Broth Gradient
      const simmer = Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 0.025;
      const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 50 * scale, -25 * scale + lightVec.y * 35 * scale, 25 * scale,
        0, 0, R_BROTH_X
      );

      brothGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(206, 126, 44, ${0.98 + simmer})`);   // Radiant golden honey center
      brothGrad.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(152, 74, 18, 0.99)`);              // Rich caramelized shoyu-miso
      brothGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#5d2607');                               // Deep umami kombu broth
      brothGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#2c1003');                              // Darkened depth near sides
      brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#130601');                                 // Meniscus rim shadow

      ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Liquid Surface Caustic Sheen & Warm Light Glaze
      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip();

      const sheenGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 75 * scale, -40 * scale + lightVec.y * 45 * scale, 15 * scale,
        lightVec.x * 70 * scale, -30 * scale + lightVec.y * 45 * scale, 160 * scale
      );
      sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 238, 200, ${0.28 + simmer * 1.5 + light.warmthPulse})`);
      sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(235, 170, 90, 0.12)');
      sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(lightVec.x * 65 * scale, -35 * scale + lightVec.y * 40 * scale, R_BROTH_X * 0.72, R_BROTH_Y * 0.58, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Draw interactive ripples on broth surface
      if (ripples.length > 0) {
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 * scale;
        for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const rip = ripples[i];
          rip.r += rip.speed;
          rip.alpha *= 0.965;

          if (rip.alpha < 0.015 || rip.r > rip.maxR) {
            ripples.splice(i, 1);
            continue;
          }

          // Light crest of ripple
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(rip.x * scale, rip.y * scale * 0.82, rip.r * scale, rip.r * 0.82 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 235, 190, ${rip.alpha * 0.55})`;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Dark trough of ripple
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(rip.x * scale, (rip.y + 1.5) * scale * 0.82, (rip.r - 2) * scale, (rip.r - 2) * 0.82 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(35, 12, 3, ${rip.alpha * 0.4})`;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      ctx.restore();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Artisanal Springy Ramen Noodles (Chukamen)
    function drawNoodles(scale, tX, tY, time) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 22, bowlCenterY + tY * 16);

      const R_BROTH_X = 236 * scale;
      const R_BROTH_Y = 192 * scale;

      // Clip inside broth
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_BROTH_X, R_BROTH_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.clip();

      // Noodle nest seed points (wavy intertwining golden ribbons)
      // Layer 1: Submerged noodles (darker, semi-translucent, softened by soup depth)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      const submergedCurves = [
        [-110, 40, -60, 85, 20, 75, 80, 50],
        [-90, 70, -30, 110, 40, 95, 110, 60],
        [-130, 10, -80, 45, -10, 60, 50, 40],
        [-40, 20, 20, 60, 70, 30, 120, -10],
        [-80, -20, -20, 15, 40, -10, 90, -40],
        [-100, 95, -40, 125, 30, 120, 90, 90],
        [-50, 80, 0, 115, 60, 80, 100, 30],
        [-120, 30, -50, 65, 10, 50, 70, 20]
      ];

      ctx.lineWidth = 5.5 * scale;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(185, 115, 38, 0.45)'; // Amber broth-submerged tone
      for (let i = 0; i < submergedCurves.length; i++) {
        const c = submergedCurves[i];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c[2] * scale, c[3] * scale, c[4] * scale, c[5] * scale, c[6] * scale, c[7] * scale);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Layer 2: Surface breaking wavy noodles (chewy, textured, glistening with hot soup)
      const surfaceCurves = [
        [-95, 35, -55, 75, 5, 65, 65, 45],
        [-75, 55, -25, 95, 35, 85, 95, 50],
        [-115, 15, -70, 40, 0, 45, 60, 25],
        [-85, 80, -35, 108, 25, 100, 80, 75],
        [-60, 25, -10, 55, 45, 40, 105, 15],
        [-35, 10, 15, 38, 65, 20, 115, -15],
        [-105, 50, -65, 88, -5, 80, 55, 60],
        [-45, 68, 5, 92, 55, 70, 95, 35],
        [-70, 95, -20, 120, 40, 110, 85, 85],
        [-15, 45, 35, 75, 75, 55, 110, 30],
        [-85, 10, -45, 30, 10, 25, 70, 5],
        [-30, 30, 20, 50, 60, 35, 100, 5]
      ];

      for (let i = 0; i < surfaceCurves.length; i++) {
        const c = surfaceCurves[i];
        
        // Base noodle shadow/body
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 5 * scale;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#c6892e';
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c[2] * scale, c[3] * scale, c[4] * scale, c[5] * scale, c[6] * scale, c[7] * scale);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Main golden alkaline wheat noodle
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 3.6 * scale;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8d272';
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c[2] * scale, c[3] * scale, c[4] * scale, c[5] * scale, c[6] * scale, c[7] * scale);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Glistening wet top highlight
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.3 * scale;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 250, 225, 0.85)';
        ctx.moveTo((c[0] - 0.6) * scale, (c[1] - 0.8) * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo((c[2] - 0.6) * scale, (c[3] - 0.8) * scale, (c[4] - 0.6) * scale, (c[5] - 0.8) * scale, (c[6] - 0.6) * scale, (c[7] - 0.8) * scale);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Floating Oil Droplets & Aromatics (Rayu, Scallion Oil, Sesame Rings)
    function drawOilDroplets(scale, tX, tY, time, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 24, bowlCenterY + tY * 18);

      const R_BROTH_X = 236 * scale;
      const R_BROTH_Y = 192 * scale;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_BROTH_X, R_BROTH_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.clip();

      const mouseInBowlX = (mouse.x - (bowlCenterX + tX * 24)) / scale;
      const mouseInBowlY = (mouse.y - (bowlCenterY + tY * 18)) / (scale * 0.82);

      for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
        const d = oilDroplets[i];

        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          // Slow thermal convection
          d.angle += d.angularSpeed;
          d.dist = d.baseDist + Math.sin(time * 0.7 + d.radialPhase) * 4;

          // Compute nominal coordinate
          const targetX = Math.cos(d.angle) * d.dist;
          const targetY = Math.sin(d.angle) * d.dist * 0.82;

          // Interactive mouse displacement (surface tension push)
          const mdx = targetX - mouseInBowlX;
          const mdy = targetY - mouseInBowlY;
          const mdist = Math.hypot(mdx, mdy);
          const pushRadius = 65;

          if (mdist < pushRadius && mdist > 0.1) {
            const force = (1 - mdist / pushRadius) * 22;
            d.vx += (mdx / mdist) * force * 0.2;
            d.vy += (mdy / mdist) * force * 0.2;
          }

          // Damping & return to orbit
          d.vx *= 0.91;
          d.vy *= 0.91;

          d.x = targetX + d.vx;
          d.y = targetY + d.vy;
        } else {
          d.x = Math.cos(d.angle) * d.dist;
          d.y = Math.sin(d.angle) * d.dist * 0.82;
        }

        const r = d.radius * scale;
        const px = d.x * scale;
        const py = d.y * scale;

        if (d.type === 'chili') {
          // Rich ruby-red chili oil globule (Rayu)
          const rayuGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
            px - r * 0.25 + lightVec.x * 2, py - r * 0.25 + lightVec.y * 2, r * 0.1,
            px, py, r
          );
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 65, 30, 0.95)');
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(205, 20, 10, 0.85)');
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(0.95, 'rgba(110, 8, 4, 0.9)');
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60, 4, 2, 0.4)');

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = rayuGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Wet specular pin-prick
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px - r * 0.32 + lightVec.x * 1.5, py - r * 0.32 + lightVec.y * 1.5, r * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 245, 235, 0.85)';
          ctx.fill();

        } else if (d.type === 'scallion') {
          // Vibrant emerald scallion aroma oil
          const scGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
            px - r * 0.2 + lightVec.x * 2, py - r * 0.2 + lightVec.y * 2, r * 0.1,
            px, py, r
          );
          scGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(140, 220, 60, 0.9)');
          scGrad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(60, 150, 30, 0.8)');
          scGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20, 65, 10, 0.4)');

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = scGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px - r * 0.3 + lightVec.x * 1.2, py - r * 0.3 + lightVec.y * 1.2, r * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 230, 0.8)';
          ctx.fill();

        } else {
          // Toasted clear sesame oil ring
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240, 175, 60, 0.55)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 * scale;
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r * 0.75, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 80, 0.15)';
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // TOPPING: Braised & Seared King Oyster Mushroom Chashu (2 Large Thick Medallions)
    function drawKingOysterChashu(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 34, bowlCenterY + tY * 24);

      function drawMedallion(cx, cy, radius, rot) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(cx * scale, cy * scale);
        ctx.rotate(rot);

        // 3D edge thickness (braised side)
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 7 * scale, radius * scale, radius * 0.85 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, radius * scale, radius * 0.85 * scale, 0, Math.PI, 0, true);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a220b';
        ctx.fill();

        // Top Caramelized Face
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, radius * scale, radius * 0.85 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

        const chashuGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          lightVec.x * 20 * scale, -10 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, 8 * scale,
          0, 0, radius * scale
        );
        chashuGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e09852');   // Savory golden tare glaze
        chashuGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#ad591d'); // Rich braised mushroom
        chashuGrad.addColorStop(0.85, '#6a2f0e'); // Deep seared edge
        chashuGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b1705');

        ctx.fillStyle = chashuGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Cross-hatch diamond knife scoring
        ctx.save();
        ctx.clip();

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#280c02'; // Deep charred cuts
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.2 * scale;
        const gridStep = 11 * scale;
        const extent = radius * scale * 1.1;

        // Diagonal lines set 1
        for (let x = -extent; x <= extent; x += gridStep) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x - extent, -extent);
          ctx.lineTo(x + extent, extent);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        // Diagonal lines set 2
        for (let x = -extent; x <= extent; x += gridStep) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x + extent, -extent);
          ctx.lineTo(x - extent, extent);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Caramelized raised ridge highlights (glossy tare sheen)
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 210, 140, 0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.3 * scale;
        for (let x = -extent; x <= extent; x += gridStep) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x - extent + 1.2 * scale, -extent);
          ctx.lineTo(x + extent + 1.2 * scale, extent);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Wet glaze specular crest
        const tareGlint = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          lightVec.x * 25 * scale, -15 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, 4 * scale,
          0, -10 * scale, radius * 0.7 * scale
        );
        tareGlint.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 245, 220, 0.6)');
        tareGlint.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 180, 90, 0.15)');
        tareGlint.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

        ctx.fillStyle = tareGlint;
        ctx.fill();

        // Cracked black pepper specks & togarashi
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0d06';
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
          const px = (Math.sin(i * 9.2) * 0.7) * radius * scale;
          const py = (Math.cos(i * 5.4) * 0.6) * radius * scale;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, 1.2 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.restore();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Medallion 1 (Lower, left of center)
      drawMedallion(-85, 38, 46, -0.25);

      // Medallion 2 (Upper left, overlapping)
      drawMedallion(-112, -8, 42, 0.35);

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // TOPPING: Whole Braised Donko Shiitake Mushroom (with Star Hanagiri Cut)
    function drawStarShiitake(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 36, bowlCenterY + tY * 25);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(-58 * scale, -90 * scale);
      ctx.rotate(0.18);

      const R = 44 * scale;

      // Mushroom cap drop shadow on broth/noodles
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(3 * scale, 8 * scale, R, R * 0.88, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 6, 2, 0.55)';
      ctx.fill();

      // Plump Umami Cap
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R, R * 0.88, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      const capGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 20 * scale, -12 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, 8 * scale,
        0, 0, R
      );
      capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#542c19');   // Warm braised mushroom top
      capGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#35190e'); // Deep umami brown
      capGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#210e07');
      capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#140703');   // Curled edge

      ctx.fillStyle = capGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Moist velvety specular highlight
      const moistSheen = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 22 * scale, -15 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, 4 * scale,
        lightVec.x * 15 * scale, -10 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, R * 0.65
      );
      moistSheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 235, 210, 0.35)');
      moistSheen.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(210, 150, 100, 0.1)');
      moistSheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = moistSheen;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R, R * 0.88, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Traditional 6-Point Japanese Hanagiri Flower/Star Cut
      // Reveals the tender pale ivory inner mushroom meat
      const numPoints = 6;
      const innerR = 7 * scale;
      const outerR = 26 * scale;

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < numPoints * 2; i++) {
        const angle = (i * Math.PI) / numPoints;
        const dist = (i % 2 === 0) ? outerR : innerR;
        const x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
        const y = Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.88;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.closePath();

      // Cream-colored interior flesh
      const cutGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2 * scale, 0, 0, outerR);
      cutGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f7efe4');   // Pure mushroom meat
      cutGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#ebdcc8');
      cutGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#c4ad93');
      cutGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a301a');   // Cut incision groove

      ctx.fillStyle = cutGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Incision depth shadow
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#321406';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 * scale;
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.restore();
      ctx.restore();
    }

        ctx.rotate(sc.rot);

        const r = sc.r * scale;

        // Outer crisp dark green rim
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r, r * 0.85, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2f6e2b';
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner tender pale-lime ring
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r * 0.82, r * 0.68, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#b6e6a8';
        ctx.fill();

        // Hollow scallion center with broth reflection
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r * 0.52, r * 0.42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a380a';
        ctx.fill();

        // Crisp cut highlight
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1 * scale;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r, r * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 0.9, Math.PI * 1.6);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      // 2. Curly Scallion Ribbons in center
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#439438';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.8 * scale;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';

      const curls = [
        [0, -10, 10, -25, 25, -20, 15, -5],
        [-10, -5, -20, -18, -15, -30, 2, -28],
        [8, 5, 20, 12, 18, -10, 5, -15]
      ];
      for (let c of curls) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c[2] * scale, c[3] * scale, c[4] * scale, c[5] * scale, c[6] * scale, c[7] * scale);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // 3. Toasted Golden Sesame Seeds
      const seeds = [
        [-75, 25], [-92, 18], [-80, 55], [-68, 42], [-105, -20],
        [-45, -78], [-58, -62], [82, -45], [92, -28], [75, 45],
        [88, 58], [12, -22], [-18, 5], [32, 12]
      ];

      for (let s of seeds) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s[0] * scale, s[1] * scale);
        ctx.rotate(s[0] * 0.1);

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 2.8 * scale, 1.6 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fae9cb'; // Toasted ivory sesame seed
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#b88c4d';
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6 * scale;
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      // 4. Crown of Spun Chili Silk (Ito Togarashi)
      // Delicate, airy fiery nest perched in the center
      const chiliThreads = [
        [-12, -5, 2, -35, 18, -42, 28, -25],
        [-8, 2, -15, -28, 5, -45, 12, -30],
        [5, -2, 16, -20, -5, -38, -18, -22],
        [-20, -12, -8, -32, 22, -36, 15, -15],
        [-4, -8, 8, -25, 28, -28, 22, -8],
        [-15, -2, 4, -18, 12, -32, -2, -40]
      ];

      ctx.lineWidth = 1.1 * scale;
      for (let i = 0; i < chiliThreads.length; i++) {
        const ct = chiliThreads[i];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ct[0] * scale, ct[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(ct[2] * scale, ct[3] * scale, ct[4] * scale, ct[5] * scale, ct[6] * scale, ct[7] * scale);

        // Glowing vermillion scarlet thread catching lantern light
        ctx.strokeStyle = (i % 2 === 0) ? '#ff4019' : '#ff7a36';
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Artisanal Stoneware Bowl Rim & Reactive Earth Glaze
    function drawBowlRim(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 18, bowlCenterY + tY * 14);

      const R_OUTER_X = 258 * scale;
      const R_OUTER_Y = 215 * scale;
      const R_INNER_X = 237 * scale;
      const R_INNER_Y = 193 * scale;

      // Heavy artisanal rim ring
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_OUTER_X, R_OUTER_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_INNER_X, R_INNER_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);

      // Reactive rust, terracotta, and toasted earth glaze
      const rimGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-R_OUTER_X, -R_OUTER_Y, R_OUTER_X, R_OUTER_Y);
      rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#5a301a');
      rimGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#8a4c28');
      rimGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#381c10');
      rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b110b');

      ctx.fillStyle = rimGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Organic pottery speckles along rim
      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(235, 185, 130, 0.15)';
      for (let a = 0; a < Math.PI * 2; a += 0.08) {
        const rx = Math.cos(a) * (R_INNER_X + (R_OUTER_X - R_INNER_X) * 0.5);
        const ry = Math.sin(a) * (R_INNER_Y + (R_OUTER_Y - R_INNER_Y) * 0.5);
        ctx.fillRect(rx, ry, 2.5 * scale, 2.5 * scale);
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // Dynamic Gloss Rim Specular Highlight (shifts with mouse light)
      const lightAngle = Math.atan2(lightVec.y, lightVec.x);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, (R_OUTER_X + R_INNER_X) * 0.5, (R_OUTER_Y + R_INNER_Y) * 0.5, 0, lightAngle - 0.7, lightAngle + 0.7);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 240, 215, 0.65)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4 * scale;
      ctx.stroke();

      // Subtle outer crisp edge
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_OUTER_X, R_OUTER_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 235, 210, 0.08)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2 * scale;
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Volumetric Whispering Steam Simulation
    function updateAndDrawSteam(scale, tX, tY, time, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 45, bowlCenterY + tY * 32);

      // Mouse position relative to steam origin
      const mouseSteamX = (mouse.x - (bowlCenterX + tX * 45));
      const mouseSteamY = (mouse.y - (bowlCenterY + tY * 32));

      // Global composite for soft glowing ethereal steam
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

      for (let i = 0; i < steamParticles.length; i++) {
        const p = steamParticles[i];
        p.life++;

        if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
          // Recycle particle
          const fresh = createSteamParticle();
          Object.assign(p, fresh);
        }

        // Buoyant ascent and fluid curl turbulence
        const progress = p.life / p.maxLife;

        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          const curl = Math.sin(p.life * p.curlFreq + p.curlSeed) * p.curlAmp;
          p.x += p.vx + curl * 0.6;
          p.y += p.vy;

          // Mouse aerodynamic disturbance (swirling steam wake)
          const distToMouse = Math.hypot(p.x * scale - mouseSteamX, p.y * scale - mouseSteamY);
          const influenceR = 120 * scale;

          if (distToMouse < influenceR && distToMouse > 1) {
            const windStrength = (1 - distToMouse / influenceR);
            p.vx += (mouse.vx * 0.15 + (p.x * scale - mouseSteamX) / distToMouse * 0.6) * windStrength;
            p.vy += (mouse.vy * 0.15) * windStrength;
          }

          p.vx *= 0.96;
        } else {
          p.y += p.vy;
        }

        // Size expansion as steam ascends and dissipates
        const currentSize = (p.size + (p.maxSize - p.size) * Math.pow(progress, 0.75)) * scale;

        // Smooth fade-in, long linger, soft dissipation
        let alpha = 0;
        if (progress < 0.2) {
          alpha = (progress / 0.2) * p.maxAlpha;
        } else if (progress < 0.65) {
          alpha = p.maxAlpha;
        } else {
          alpha = (1 - (progress - 0.65) / 0.35) * p.maxAlpha;
        }

        if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

        const px = p.x * scale;
        const py = p.y * scale;

        // Dual-color gradient: warm golden core near soup, cool ethereal vapor aloft
        const steamGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, currentSize);
        if (py > -80 * scale) {
          // Near hot broth: catches amber-gold glow
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 225, 185, ${alpha * 1.2})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255, 210, 165, ${alpha * 0.7})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(230, 210, 190, 0)');
        } else {
          // Billowing into dark air: soft luminous warm white
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(248, 242, 235, ${alpha * 0.9})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(235, 230, 225, ${alpha * 0.45})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(210, 210, 210, 0)');
        }

        ctx.fillStyle = steamGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, currentSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Heat Haze & Cinematic Lighting Vignette
    function drawVignetteAndGlow(time, lightVec) {
      // Warm breathing lantern light pulsing over the entire bowl
      const pulse = Math.sin(time * 0.8) * 0.02 + light.warmthPulse;
      light.warmthPulse *= 0.95;

      const lanternGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        bowlCenterX + lightVec.x * 60 * baseScale, bowlCenterY - 100 * baseScale + lightVec.y * 50 * baseScale, 50 * baseScale,
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, 380 * baseScale
      );
      lanternGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 175, 75, ${0.11 + pulse})`);
      lanternGlow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(215, 120, 35, ${0.05 + pulse * 0.5})`);
      lanternGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
      ctx.fillStyle = lanternGlow;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      ctx.restore();

      // Deep cinematic perimeter vignette (keeps viewer focus locked purely on ramen)
      const vigGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, Math.min(width, height) * 0.35,
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, Math.max(width, height) * 0.75
      );
      vigGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
      vigGrad.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(3, 2, 2, 0.45)');
      vigGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.92)');

      ctx.fillStyle = vigGrad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    }

    // Main 60FPS Render & Physics Loop
    let lastTimestamp = performance.now();

    function render(timestamp) {
      const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 1000, 0.05);
      lastTimestamp = timestamp;
      const time = timestamp * 0.001;

      // Smooth mouse tracking & velocity
      const dMouseX = mouse.targetX - mouse.x;
      const dMouseY = mouse.targetY - mouse.y;
      mouse.vx = dMouseX * 0.25;
      mouse.vy = dMouseY * 0.25;
      mouse.x += dMouseX * 0.18;
      mouse.y += dMouseY * 0.18;

      // Calculate 3D Parallax Tilt from pointer position
      if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
        const normX = (mouse.x - bowlCenterX) / (width * 0.5);
        const normY = (mouse.y - bowlCenterY) / (height * 0.5);
        tilt.targetX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, normX)) * 0.75;
        tilt.targetY = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, normY)) * 0.55;

        tilt.x += (tilt.targetX - tilt.x) * 0.06;
        tilt.y += (tilt.targetY - tilt.y) * 0.06;

        // Dynamic light vector follows mouse with smooth damped inertia
        light.targetX = normX * 0.65;
        light.targetY = -0.55 + normY * 0.35;
        light.x += (light.targetX - light.x) * 0.08;
        light.y += (light.targetY - light.y) * 0.08;
      } else {
        tilt.x = 0;
        tilt.y = 0;
        light.x = 0;
        light.y = -0.6;
      }

      // Check if mouse is hovering over broth
      const dxFromCenter = (mouse.x - bowlCenterX) / baseScale;
      const dyFromCenter = (mouse.y - bowlCenterY) / baseScale;
      const distFromCenter = Math.hypot(dxFromCenter, dyFromCenter / 0.82);

      if (distFromCenter < 210) {
        if (!mouse.isHoveringBowl) {
          mouse.isHoveringBowl = true;
          addRipple(dxFromCenter, dyFromCenter, 80, 0.8);
        } else if (Math.hypot(mouse.vx, mouse.vy) > 1.2 && Math.random() < 0.18) {
          addRipple(dxFromCenter, dyFromCenter, 70, 0.5);
        }
      } else {
        mouse.isHoveringBowl = false;
      }

      // Render Scene Layers in depth order
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      drawDarkTable(time);
      drawBowlShadow(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y);
      drawBowlBody(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawBrothSurface(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, time, light);
      drawNoodles(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, time);
      drawNoriSheets(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawBokChoy(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawKingOysterChashu(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawStarShiitake(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawVeganAjitsukeEgg(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawMenma(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawOilDroplets(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, time, light);
      drawGarnish(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      drawBowlRim(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, light);
      updateAndDrawSteam(baseScale, tilt.x, tilt.y, time, light);
      drawVignetteAndGlow(time, light);

      requestAnimationFrame(render);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  })();
  </script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
  <title>Artisanal Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #060504;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }
    body:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
    #ramen-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      display: block;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="ramen-canvas"></canvas>

  <script>
  (function() {
    'use strict';

    const canvas = document.getElementById('ramen-canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

    // Accessibility: prefers-reduced-motion detection
    let prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').addEventListener('change', e => {
      prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
    });

    // Screen dimensions & DPI
    let width = 0;
    let height = 0;
    let dpr = 1;
    let bowlCenterX = 0;
    let bowlCenterY = 0;
    let baseScale = 1;

    // Mouse & Pointer State
    const mouse = {
      x: window.innerWidth / 2,
      y: window.innerHeight / 2,
      targetX: window.innerWidth / 2,
      targetY: window.innerHeight / 2,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      lastX: window.innerWidth / 2,
      lastY: window.innerHeight / 2,
      isDown: false,
      isHoveringBowl: false
    };

    // Parallax Tilt State
    const tilt = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      targetX: 0,
      targetY: 0
    };

    // Dynamic Lighting
    const light = {
      x: 0,
      y: -0.6,
      targetX: 0,
      targetY: -0.6,
      intensity: 1.0,
      warmthPulse: 0
    };

    // Interactive Ripples on broth
    const ripples = [];

    function addRipple(x, y, maxR = 90, strength = 1.0) {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
      ripples.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        r: 4,
        maxR: maxR,
        alpha: 0.65 * strength,
        speed: 1.4 + Math.random() * 0.4
      });
      if (ripples.length > 8) ripples.shift();
    }

    // Floating Oil Droplets (Rayu chili oil, aromatic scallion oil, sesame oil)
    const oilDroplets = [];
    const NUM_DROPLETS = 52;

    function initOilDroplets() {
      oilDroplets.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < NUM_DROPLETS; i++) {
        // Distribute within broth radius (~220 in bowl coords)
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        // Biased slightly toward edges and gaps between toppings
        const distRatio = 0.25 + 0.68 * Math.sqrt(Math.random());
        const baseR = distRatio * 205;
        
        // Types: 0: Chili oil (Rayu red), 1: Scallion oil (Jade green), 2: Sesame oil (Golden amber)
        const rand = Math.random();
        const type = rand < 0.5 ? 'chili' : (rand < 0.75 ? 'scallion' : 'sesame');
        const radius = type === 'chili' ? (2.5 + Math.random() * 6) : (type === 'scallion' ? (3 + Math.random() * 5.5) : (4 + Math.random() * 7));

        oilDroplets.push({
          angle: angle,
          dist: baseR,
          baseDist: baseR,
          angularSpeed: (0.0008 + Math.random() * 0.0016) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1),
          radialOffset: 0,
          radialPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          radius: radius,
          type: type,
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          vx: 0,
          vy: 0
        });
      }
    }

    // Steam Simulation Particles
    const steamParticles = [];
    const MAX_STEAM = 160;

    function createSteamParticle(initY = null) {
      // Spawn within the hot broth area, concentrated where broth is exposed
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const r = (Math.random() * 0.85) * 190;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * r * 1.05;
      const y = initY !== null ? initY : Math.sin(angle) * r * 0.82;

      const maxLife = prefersReducedMotion ? (240 + Math.random() * 100) : (140 + Math.random() * 110);

      return {
        x: x,
        y: y,
        spawnX: x,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
        vy: prefersReducedMotion ? -(0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4) : -(1.1 + Math.random() * 1.3),
        size: 14 + Math.random() * 12,
        maxSize: 65 + Math.random() * 55,
        alpha: 0,
        maxAlpha: 0.07 + Math.random() * 0.07,
        life: 0,
        maxLife: maxLife,
        curlSeed: Math.random() * 100,
        curlFreq: 0.022 + Math.random() * 0.018,
        curlAmp: prefersReducedMotion ? 0.15 : (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.9),
        depth: 1.1 + Math.random() * 0.5
      };
    }

    function initSteam() {
      steamParticles.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_STEAM; i++) {
        const p = createSteamParticle(-100 + Math.random() * 200);
        p.life = Math.random() * p.maxLife;
        steamParticles.push(p);
      }
    }

    // Ambient floating dust motes catching lantern light
    const motes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
      motes.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random(),
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.0004,
        vy: -0.0003 - Math.random() * 0.0006,
        size: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.8,
        alpha: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    // Responsive Canvas Resize
    function resize() {
      dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      width = window.innerWidth;
      height = window.innerHeight;

      canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);

      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

      bowlCenterX = width / 2;
      // Position bowl comfortably in lower-middle third
      bowlCenterY = height * 0.52;

      // Base scale: target ~540px bowl diameter on standard screens, responsive on mobile & large screens
      const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
      baseScale = Math.max(0.48, Math.min(1.22, minDim / 680));
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();
    initOilDroplets();
    initSteam();

    // Event Listeners for Smooth Mouse & Touch Response
    function updatePointer(clientX, clientY) {
      mouse.targetX = clientX;
      mouse.targetY = clientY;
    }

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
      updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    }, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
      mouse.isDown = true;
      updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);

      // Check if clicking inside bowl
      const dx = (e.clientX - bowlCenterX) / baseScale;
      const dy = (e.clientY - bowlCenterY) / baseScale;
      if (dx * dx + (dy / 0.8) * (dy / 0.8) < 220 * 220) {
        addRipple(dx, dy, 120, 1.4);
        light.warmthPulse = 0.25;

        // Puff of steam on gentle tap/click
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          if (steamParticles.length < MAX_STEAM + 20) {
            const p = createSteamParticle(dy);
            p.x = dx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            p.vy *= 1.35;
            p.maxAlpha *= 1.25;
            steamParticles.push(p);
          }
        }
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      mouse.isDown = false;
    });

    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
      mouse.isDown = false;
    });

    // Drawing Helpers
    function drawDarkTable(time) {
      // Atmospheric dark wood noodle counter
      const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        bowlCenterX + light.x * 60, bowlCenterY - 180 * baseScale + light.y * 40, 40 * baseScale,
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, Math.max(width, height) * 0.85
      );
      
      // Warm lantern cone fading to deep pitch black charred cedar
      const pulse = Math.sin(time * 0.9) * 0.015;
      bgGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(46, 26, 14, ${0.48 + pulse})`);
      bgGrad.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(24, 15, 9, ${0.75 + pulse})`);
      bgGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#0b0908');
      bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#040302');

      ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Subtle horizontal wood grain textures
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.045;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#deb887';
      const grainStep = 9 * baseScale;
      const startY = Math.floor((bowlCenterY - 300 * baseScale) / grainStep) * grainStep;
      for (let y = startY; y < height; y += grainStep) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1 + (Math.sin(y * 0.07) + 1) * 0.75;
        ctx.moveTo(0, y + Math.sin(y * 0.03) * 4);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          width * 0.33, y + Math.cos(y * 0.04) * 5,
          width * 0.66, y - Math.sin(y * 0.05) * 4,
          width, y + Math.cos(y * 0.03) * 3
        );
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // Atmospheric floating warm dust motes
      ctx.save();
      for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
        const m = motes[i];
        m.y += m.vy;
        m.x += m.vx + Math.sin(time * 0.5 + m.phase) * 0.0003;
        if (m.y < 0) m.y = 1;
        if (m.x < 0) m.x = 1;
        if (m.x > 1) m.x = 0;

        const px = m.x * width;
        const py = m.y * height;
        // Fade motes near boundaries and brighten near lantern beam
        const distFromCenter = Math.hypot(px - bowlCenterX, py - (bowlCenterY - 120));
        const beamIntensity = Math.max(0, 1 - distFromCenter / (420 * baseScale));

        if (beamIntensity > 0.05) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, m.size * baseScale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 160, ${m.alpha * beamIntensity * 0.8})`;
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Shadow cast by heavy stoneware bowl on table
    function drawBowlShadow(scale, tX, tY) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * -12, bowlCenterY + 45 * scale + tY * -8);

      const contactGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 45 * scale, 30 * scale, 0, 45 * scale, 250 * scale);

      contactGrad.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.75)');
      contactGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(8, 5, 3, 0.35)');
      contactGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 45 * scale, 255 * scale, 125 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = contactGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Soft ambient table bounce from warm golden broth
      const bounceGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 50 * scale, 80 * scale, 0, 60 * scale, 270 * scale);
      bounceGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(215, 115, 30, 0.08)');
      bounceGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(160, 70, 10, 0.03)');

    // Stoneware Donburi Outer Vessel & Glaze
    function drawBowlBody(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 6, bowlCenterY + tY * 4);

      const R_OUTER_X = 258 * scale;
      const R_OUTER_Y = 215 * scale;
      const FOOT_R_X = 115 * scale;
      const FOOT_R_Y = 55 * scale;
      const BOWL_DEPTH = 135 * scale;

      // Outer vessel body path
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_OUTER_X, R_OUTER_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI); // Top rim half (front)
      // Taper down to heavy ceramic foot
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(
        R_OUTER_X * 0.95, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.55,
        FOOT_R_X * 1.35, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.95,
        FOOT_R_X, BOWL_DEPTH
      );
      ctx.ellipse(0, BOWL_DEPTH, FOOT_R_X, FOOT_R_Y * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI, false);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(
        -FOOT_R_X * 1.35, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.95,
        -R_OUTER_X * 0.95, BOWL_DEPTH * 0.55,
        -R_OUTER_X, 0
      );
      ctx.closePath();

      // Deep matte tenmoku / iron-black glaze with warm clay gradient
      const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-R_OUTER_X, -50 * scale, R_OUTER_X, BOWL_DEPTH);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1c1b1f');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.25, '#121214');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#0c0b0d');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.9, '#1a1410'); // warm unglazed clay near foot
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#110c08');

      ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Concentric hand-thrown pottery ribs
      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 235, 210, 0.035)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 * scale;
      for (let r = 0.2; r < 0.95; r += 0.16) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, BOWL_DEPTH * r, (R_OUTER_X * (1 - r * 0.45)), (R_OUTER_Y * 0.45 * (1 - r * 0.3)), 0, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Dynamic specular highlight on curved ceramic body
      const bodyHighlight = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 120 * scale, 40 * scale + lightVec.y * 30 * scale, 10 * scale,
        lightVec.x * 120 * scale, 50 * scale + lightVec.y * 30 * scale, 180 * scale
      );
      bodyHighlight.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 240, 215, 0.12)');
      bodyHighlight.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(220, 180, 140, 0.04)');
      bodyHighlight.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = bodyHighlight;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Rich Broth Surface, Golden Sheen & Convective Convection
    function drawBrothSurface(scale, tX, tY, time, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 16, bowlCenterY + tY * 12);

      const R_BROTH_X = 236 * scale;
      const R_BROTH_Y = 192 * scale;

      // Broth clipping mask
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_BROTH_X, R_BROTH_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      // Deep Tonkotsu-Shoyu Vegan Broth Gradient
      const simmer = Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 0.025;
      const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 50 * scale, -25 * scale + lightVec.y * 35 * scale, 25 * scale,
        0, 0, R_BROTH_X
      );

      brothGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(206, 126, 44, ${0.98 + simmer})`);   // Radiant golden honey center
      brothGrad.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(152, 74, 18, 0.99)`);              // Rich caramelized shoyu-miso
      brothGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#5d2607');                               // Deep umami kombu broth
      brothGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#2c1003');                              // Darkened depth near sides
      brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#130601');                                 // Meniscus rim shadow

      ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Liquid Surface Caustic Sheen & Warm Light Glaze
      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip();

      const sheenGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        lightVec.x * 75 * scale, -40 * scale + lightVec.y * 45 * scale, 15 * scale,
        lightVec.x * 70 * scale, -30 * scale + lightVec.y * 45 * scale, 160 * scale
      );
      sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 238, 200, ${0.28 + simmer * 1.5 + light.warmthPulse})`);
      sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(235, 170, 90, 0.12)');
      sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(lightVec.x * 65 * scale, -35 * scale + lightVec.y * 40 * scale, R_BROTH_X * 0.72, R_BROTH_Y * 0.58, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Draw interactive ripples on broth surface
      if (ripples.length > 0) {
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 * scale;
        for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const rip = ripples[i];
          rip.r += rip.speed;
          rip.alpha *= 0.965;

          if (rip.alpha < 0.015 || rip.r > rip.maxR) {
            ripples.splice(i, 1);
            continue;
          }

          // Light crest of ripple
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(rip.x * scale, rip.y * scale * 0.82, rip.r * scale, rip.r * 0.82 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 235, 190, ${rip.alpha * 0.55})`;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Dark trough of ripple
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(rip.x * scale, (rip.y + 1.5) * scale * 0.82, (rip.r - 2) * scale, (rip.r - 2) * 0.82 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(35, 12, 3, ${rip.alpha * 0.4})`;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      ctx.restore();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Artisanal Springy Ramen Noodles (Chukamen)
    function drawNoodles(scale, tX, tY, time) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 22, bowlCenterY + tY * 16);

      ctx.beginPath();

      // Layer 1: Submerged noodles (darker, semi-translucent, softened by soup depth)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      const submergedCurves = [
        [-110, 40, -60, 85, 20, 75, 80, 50],
        [-90, 70, -30, 110, 40, 95, 110, 60],
        [-130, 10, -80, 45, -10, 60, 50, 40],
        [-40, 20, 20, 60, 70, 30, 120, -10],
        [-80, -20, -20, 15, 40, -10, 90, -40],
        [-100, 95, -40, 125, 30, 120, 90, 90],
        [-50, 80, 0, 115, 60, 80, 100, 30],
        [-120, 30, -50, 65, 10, 50, 70, 20]
      ];

      ctx.lineWidth = 5.5 * scale;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(185, 115, 38, 0.45)'; // Amber broth-submerged tone
      for (let i = 0; i < submergedCurves.length; i++) {
        const c = submergedCurves[i];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);

      }

      // Layer 2: Surface breaking wavy noodles (chewy, textured, glistening with hot soup)
      const surfaceCurves = [
        [-95, 35, -55, 75, 5, 65, 65, 45],
        [-75, 55, -25, 95, 35, 85, 95, 50],
        [-115, 15, -70, 40, 0, 45, 60, 25],
        [-85, 80, -35, 108, 25, 100, 80, 75],
        [-60, 25, -10, 55, 45, 40, 105, 15],
        [-35, 10, 15, 38, 65, 20, 115, -15],
        [-105, 50, -65, 88, -5, 80, 55, 60],
        [-45, 68, 5, 92, 55, 70, 95, 35],
        [-70, 95, -20, 120, 40, 110, 85, 85],
        [-15, 45, 35, 75, 75, 55, 110, 30],
        [-85, 10, -45, 30, 10, 25, 70, 5],
        [-30, 30, 20, 50, 60, 35, 100, 5]
      ];

      for (let i = 0; i < surfaceCurves.length; i++) {
        const c = surfaceCurves[i];
        
        // Base noodle shadow/body
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 5 * scale;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#c6892e';
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c[2] * scale, c[3] * scale, c[4] * scale, c[5] * scale, c[6] * scale, c[7] * scale);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Main golden alkaline wheat noodle
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 3.6 * scale;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8d272';
        ctx.moveTo(c[0] * scale, c[1] * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c[2] * scale, c[3] * scale, c[4] * scale, c[5] * scale, c[6] * scale, c[7] * scale);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Glistening wet top highlight
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.3 * scale;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 250, 225, 0.85)';
        ctx.moveTo((c[0] - 0.6) * scale, (c[1] - 0.8) * scale);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo((c[2] - 0.6) * scale, (c[3] - 0.8) * scale, (c[4] - 0.6) * scale, (c[5] - 0.8) * scale, (c[6] - 0.6) * scale, (c[7] - 0.8) * scale);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Floating Oil Droplets & Aromatics (Rayu, Scallion Oil, Sesame Rings)
    function drawOilDroplets(scale, tX, tY, time, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 24, bowlCenterY + tY * 18);

      const R_BROTH_X = 236 * scale;
      const R_BROTH_Y = 192 * scale;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R_BROTH_X, R_BROTH_Y, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.clip();

      const mouseInBowlX = (mouse.x - (bowlCenterX + tX * 24)) / scale;
      const mouseInBowlY = (mouse.y - (bowlCenterY + tY * 18)) / (scale * 0.82);

      for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
        const d = oilDroplets[i];

        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          // Slow thermal convection
          d.angle += d.angularSpeed;
          d.dist = d.baseDist + Math.sin(time * 0.7 + d.radialPhase) * 4;

          // Compute nominal coordinate
          const targetX = Math.cos(d.angle) * d.dist;
          const targetY = Math.sin(d.angle) * d.dist * 0.82;

          // Interactive mouse displacement (surface tension push)
          const mdx = targetX - mouseInBowlX;
          const mdy = targetY - mouseInBowlY;
          const mdist = Math.hypot(mdx, mdy);
          const pushRadius = 65;

          if (mdist < pushRadius && mdist > 0.1) {
            const force = (1 - mdist / pushRadius) * 22;
            d.vx += (mdx / mdist) * force * 0.2;
            d.vy += (mdy / mdist) * force * 0.2;
          }

          // Damping & return to orbit
          d.vx *= 0.91;
          d.vy *= 0.91;

          d.x = targetX + d.vx;
          d.y = targetY + d.vy;
        } else {
          d.x = Math.cos(d.angle) * d.dist;
          d.y = Math.sin(d.angle) * d.dist * 0.82;
        }

        const r = d.radius * scale;
        const px = d.x * scale;
        const py = d.y * scale;

        if (d.type === 'chili') {
          // Rich ruby-red chili oil globule (Rayu)
          const rayuGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
            px - r * 0.25 + lightVec.x * 2, py - r * 0.25 + lightVec.y * 2, r * 0.1,
            px, py, r
          );
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 65, 30, 0.95)');
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(205, 20, 10, 0.85)');
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(0.95, 'rgba(110, 8, 4, 0.9)');
          rayuGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60, 4, 2, 0.4)');

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = rayuGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Wet specular pin-prick
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px - r * 0.32 + lightVec.x * 1.5, py - r * 0.32 + lightVec.y * 1.5, r * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 245, 235, 0.85)';
          ctx.fill();

        } else if (d.type === 'scallion') {
          // Vibrant emerald scallion aroma oil
          const scGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
            px - r * 0.2 + lightVec.x * 2, py - r * 0.2 + lightVec.y * 2, r * 0.1,
            px, py, r
          );
          scGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(140, 220, 60, 0.9)');
          scGrad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(60, 150, 30, 0.8)');
          scGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20, 65, 10, 0.4)');

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = scGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px - r * 0.3 + lightVec.x * 1.2, py - r * 0.3 + lightVec.y * 1.2, r * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 230, 0.8)';
          ctx.fill();

        } else {
          // Toasted clear sesame oil ring
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240, 175, 60, 0.55)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 * scale;
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, r * 0.75, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 80, 0.15)';
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // TOPPING: Crisp Baby Bok Choy (Pak Choi)
    function drawBokChoy(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {

    // TOPPING: Braised & Seared King Oyster Mushroom Chashu (2 Large Thick Medallions)
    function drawKingOysterChashu(scale, tX, tY, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 34, bowlCenterY + tY * 24);

      function drawMedallion(cx, cy, radius, rot) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(cx * scale, cy * scale);
        ctx.rotate(rot);

        // 3D edge thickness (braised side)
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 7 * scale, radius * scale, radius * 0.85 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, radius * scale, radius * 0.85 * scale, 0, Math.PI, 0, true);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a220b';
        ctx.fill();

        // Top Caramelized Face
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, radius * scale, radius * 0.85 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

        const chashuGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          lightVec.x * 20 * scale, -10 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, 8 * scale,

        // Cross-hatch diamond knife scoring

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#280c02'; // Deep charred cuts

        const gridStep = 11 * scale;

        // Diagonal lines set 1
        for (let x = -extent; x <= extent; x += gridStep) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x - extent, -extent);
          ctx.lineTo(x + extent, extent);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        // Diagonal lines set 2
        for (let x = -extent; x <= extent; x += gridStep) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x + extent, -extent);
          ctx.lineTo(x - extent, extent);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Caramelized raised ridge highlights (glossy tare sheen)
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 210, 140, 0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.3 * scale;
        for (let x = -extent; x <= extent; x += gridStep) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x - extent + 1.2 * scale, -extent);
          ctx.lineTo(x + extent + 1.2 * scale, extent);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Wet glaze specular crest
        const tareGlint = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          lightVec.x * 25 * scale, -15 * scale + lightVec.y * 15 * scale, 4 * scale,

        ctx.fillStyle = tareGlint;
        ctx.fill();

        // Cracked black pepper specks & togarashi

        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, 1.2 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);

        }

        ctx.restore();
        ctx.restore();

      // Medallion 1 (Lower, left of center)

    // Volumetric Whispering Steam Simulation
    function updateAndDrawSteam(scale, tX, tY, time, lightVec) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + tX * 45, bowlCenterY + tY * 32);

      // Mouse position relative to steam origin
      const mouseSteamX = (mouse.x - (bowlCenterX + tX * 45));
      const mouseSteamY = (mouse.y - (bowlCenterY + tY * 32));

      // Global composite for soft glowing ethereal steam
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

      for (let i = 0; i < steamParticles.length; i++) {
        const p = steamParticles[i];
        p.life++;

        if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
          // Recycle particle
          const fresh = createSteamParticle();
          Object.assign(p, fresh);
        }

        // Buoyant ascent and fluid curl turbulence
        const progress = p.life / p.maxLife;

        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          const curl = Math.sin(p.life * p.curlFreq + p.curlSeed) * p.curlAmp;
          p.x += p.vx + curl * 0.6;
          p.y += p.vy;

          // Mouse aerodynamic disturbance (swirling steam wake)
          const distToMouse = Math.hypot(p.x * scale - mouseSteamX, p.y * scale - mouseSteamY);
          const influenceR = 120 * scale;

          if (distToMouse < influenceR && distToMouse > 1) {
            const windStrength = (1 - distToMouse / influenceR);
            p.vx += (mouse.vx * 0.15 + (p.x * scale - mouseSteamX) / distToMouse * 0.6) * windStrength;
            p.vy += (mouse.vy * 0.15) * windStrength;
          }

          p.vx *= 0.96;
        } else {
          p.y += p.vy;
        }

        // Size expansion as steam ascends and dissipates
        const currentSize = (p.size + (p.maxSize - p.size) * Math.pow(progress, 0.75)) * scale;

        // Smooth fade-in, long linger, soft dissipation
        let alpha = 0;
        if (progress < 0.2) {
          alpha = (progress / 0.2) * p.maxAlpha;
        } else if (progress < 0.65) {
          alpha = p.maxAlpha;
        } else {
          alpha = (1 - (progress - 0.65) / 0.35) * p.maxAlpha;
        }

        if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

        const px = p.x * scale;
        const py = p.y * scale;

        // Dual-color gradient: warm golden core near soup, cool ethereal vapor aloft
        const steamGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, currentSize);
        if (py > -80 * scale) {
          // Near hot broth: catches amber-gold glow
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 225, 185, ${alpha * 1.2})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255, 210, 165, ${alpha * 0.7})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(230, 210, 190, 0)');
        } else {
          // Billowing into dark air: soft luminous warm white
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(248, 242, 235, ${alpha * 0.9})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(235, 230, 225, ${alpha * 0.45})`);
          steamGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(210, 210, 210, 0)');
        }

        ctx.fillStyle = steamGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, currentSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Heat Haze & Cinematic Lighting Vignette
    function drawVignetteAndGlow(time, lightVec) {
      // Warm breathing lantern light pulsing over the entire bowl
      const pulse = Math.sin(time * 0.8) * 0.02 + light.warmthPulse;
      light.warmthPulse *= 0.95;

      const lanternGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        bowlCenterX + lightVec.x * 60 * baseScale, bowlCenterY - 100 * baseScale + lightVec.y * 50 * baseScale, 50 * baseScale,
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, 380 * baseScale
      );
      lanternGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 175, 75, ${0.11 + pulse})`);
      lanternGlow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(215, 120, 35, ${0.05 + pulse * 0.5})`);
      lanternGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
      ctx.fillStyle = lanternGlow;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      ctx.restore();

      // Deep cinematic perimeter vignette (keeps viewer focus locked purely on ramen)
      const vigGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, Math.min(width, height) * 0.35,
        bowlCenterX, bowlCenterY, Math.max(width, height) * 0.75
      );
      vigGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
      vigGrad.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(3, 2, 2, 0.45)');
      vigGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.92)');

      ctx.fillStyle = vigGrad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    }

    // Main 60FPS Render & Physics Loop
